education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the

1. Scope — Covers requirements for assembly details and identification of screw plug gauges and 
screw check plugs for ISO metric screw threads in the size range from M1 up to and including M200.

3. Designation 

3.1 For Nominal Size from 1 mm up to and including 65 mm ( Double Ended ) 

3.1.1 A GO and NO GO screw plug gauge and screw check plug gauge for ISO metric screw threads 
shall be designated by the nominal diamster pitch and the tolerance class. If pitch is not indicated 
in the designation, coarse pitch is implied. 

Examples : 

1) A GO and NO GO screw plug gauge of thread size M20, pitch 2 mm and tolerance class 
6H shall be designated as: 

GO and NO GO Screw Plug Gauge M20x2-6H IS : 7018 (Part 3) 

2) A GO and NO GO screw check plug gauge for new solid GO screw ring gauge of 
nominal diameter M60, pitch 3 mm and tolerance class 6g shall be designated as: * 

GO and NO GO Screw Check Plug Gauge M60x3-6g CP 
for GO Screw Ring Gauge IS : 7018 (Part 3) 

3) A GO and NO GO screw check plug gauge for new solid NO GO screw ring gauge of 
nominal diameter M60, pitch 3 mm and tolerance class 6g shall be designated as: 

GO and NO GO Screw Check Plug Gauge M60x3-6g 
CP For NO GO Screw Ring Gauge IS : 7018 (Part 3) 

3.2 For Nominal Size above 65 mm up to and Including 200 mm {Single Ended) 

3.2.1 A GO or NO GO screw plug gauge and screw check plug gauge for ISO metric screw threads 
shall be designated by the nominal diameter, pitch and the tolerance class. If pitch is not indicated in 
the designation, coarse pitch is implied. 



IS: 7018 ( Part 3) -1983 

Examples : 

1) A GO or NO GO screw plug gauge of thread size M80, pitch 2 mm and tolerance class 
6H shall be designated as: 

GO Screw Plug Gauge M80X2-6H IS : 7018 (Part 3) 

NO GO Screw Plug Gauge M80X2-6H IS : 7018 (Part 3) 

2) A GO or NO GO screw check plgg gauge for new solid GO screw ring gauge of nominal 
diameter M80, pitch 2 mm and tolerance class 6g shall be designated as: 

GO Screw Check Plug Gauge M80x2-6g CP for 
GO Screw Ring Gauge IS : 7018 (Part 3) 

NO GO Screw Check Plug Gauge M80 x2-6g CP for 
GO Screw Ring Gauge IS : 7018 (Part 3) 

3) A GO or NO GO screw check plug gauge for new solid NO GO screw ring gauge of 
nominal diameter M80, pitch 2 mm and tolerance class 6g shall be designated as: 

GO Screw Check Plug Gauge M80 x 2-6g CP for NO GO 
Screw Ring Gauge IS : 7018 (Part 3) 

NO GO Screw Check Plug Gauge M80x2-6g CP for NO GO 
Screw Ring Gauge IS • 7018 (Part 3) 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard on technical supply conditions for different types of gauges, issued in various parts, 
has been brought out to avoid mentioning on the standard sheets or drawings of gauges the details which 
are of repetitive nature and which supplement the details already existing. It would be enough to refer 
to this standard wherever the gauges are to comply with these requirements. 

This standard (Part 3) was originally published in 1980. It has now been revised to bring it in line 
with the latest manufacturing practices in this field in the country. Alterations have been made in 
Fig 1 to 3 and the clauses on designation beside extending the scope of the standard to include gauges 
of sizes up to M200. 

Other parts of the standard are as follows: 

IS : 7018 (Part 1)-1983 Technical supply conditions for gauges- Parti General {first revision ) 

IS : 7018 (Part 2) -1983 Technical supply conditions for gauges : Part 2 Assembly and identifi- 
cation of plain plug gauges (size range from 1 up to and including 250 mm) ( first revision ) 



Reprography Unit, BIS. New Delhi, India
